caption:
The truck left at 6 AM. The customer called at 11.

Every dispatch means copying the LR number, updating the sheet and messaging each customer.
A small automation can take one entry, update the dispatch sheet and send every customer their truck details.

Example data.

Follow for one business automation every day. Send this to whoever handles your dispatches.

scenes.vo: Every dispatch means copying the LR number, updating the sheet, and *messaging* each customer. One by one.
Here is the *fix.* The dispatch sheet updates itself from one entry.
It *copies* the LR number, *adds* it to the dispatch sheet, and *messages* the customer.
Then it *forwards* the POD to the customer. Nobody calls the transporter again.
Follow for one dispatch automation every day.

title: The dispatch update nobody sends

message.text: Hi Sharma ji, your goods left today. Truck HR38 4521, ETA tomorrow 11 AM.
